stories.title: Hash Chaining and Tamper-Evident Integrity
stories.description: Extend audit log entries with cryptographic hash chaining (each record includes hash of previous record) to make tampering detectable. Provide verification utility to validate full chain integrity.
stories.evidence: ASSUMPTION: Append-only alone is insufficient for tamper detection; hash chaining is a standard audit pattern. GAP: No existing hash-chain implementation found in debug_logger or audit artifacts.

stories.title: Immutable Storage Enforcement (Database-Level)
stories.description: Implement database-level protections (e.g., MongoDB schema rules, restricted roles, or write-once collection pattern) to prevent update/delete operations on audit records.
stories.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py; ASSUMPTION: Current Mongo usage allows writes but does not enforce immutability. GAP: No explicit append-only enforcement mechanism present.

stories.title: Audit Log Partitioning and Retention Policy
stories.description: Define and implement time-based partitioning (e.g., daily/weekly collections) and retention configuration to ensure audit logs remain performant and queryable without deletion of historical data.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/atlas_cluster_manager.py; ASSUMPTION: High-volume logs will require partitioning for performance. GAP: No retention/partitioning strategy defined in current logging.

stories.title: Audit Logging Failure Handling and Fallback
stories.description: Ensure that failures in audit logging (e.g., DB outage) trigger fallback mechanisms such as buffered writes or error escalation, and never silently drop audit events.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py; Code/Shared/cost_guard.py; ASSUMPTION: Current logging may fail without guaranteed persistence. GAP: No explicit fallback or durability guarantee documented.
